fullDescription: Enterprise Invoice Editor style guide featuring a high-contrast split-screen layout. It uses a premium dark-themed form editor on the left and a professional light-themed document preview on the right. Key characteristics include editorial typography (Cabinet Grotesk & Satoshi), sophisticated neutral scales with amber accents (#fcd34d), and glassmorphism-inspired container styles. Ideal for fintech, SaaS dashboards, and professional billing software where clarity and premium aesthetics are paramount. Includes detail-oriented components like auto-calculating totals, tiered item rows, and high-fidelity invoice templates.

structured.summary: A sophisticated, split-screen enterprise UI for document creation. It balances a dark-mode data entry interface with a light-mode high-fidelity preview, utilizing premium typography and subtle depth through inset shadows and gradients.

style.description: Premium enterprise aesthetic blending dark-mode productivity with light-mode fidelity. Features Cabinet Grotesk for high-impact display headers and Satoshi for legible body text. The palette centers on neutral grays (#0a0a0a, #fafafa) with amber-300 (#fcd34d) as the primary action color. Design elements include 24px/16px rounded corners, 1px subtle borders (white/10 for dark, neutral-200 for light), and soft-depth shadows.
style.prompt: Implement a premium split-screen design system. Typography: Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' (500, 600) for display headers/totals and 'Satoshi' (400, 500, 700) for body and form fields. Color Palette: Dark surface #0a0a0a, Accent #fcd34d (Amber-300), Success #34d399 (Emerald-400), Preview background #fafafa, Preview card #ffffff. Borders: Use white/10 (opacity 0.1) for dark mode containers and #e5e5e5 (Neutral-200) for light mode. Shadows: Apply soft-xl shadow (0 30px 60px -30px rgba(0,0,0,0.65)) and inset-soft (inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06)) to dark containers. Animations: Use 'fadeUp' (opacity 0 to 1, translateY 10px to 0px over 600ms ease-out) with staggered delays for section entries. Inputs: Use #171717 background with white/10 border, 12px border-radius, and 10px vertical padding.

layout_and_structure.description: A top-down layout within a 1440px container, featuring a fixed-width header and a 12-column grid that splits into 5/7 or 6/6 proportions for editor/preview interactions.

prompts.prompt: Create a persistent top navigation bar (80px height) with a bottom border (white/10). Left side: 40px icon container (rounded-xl, bg-white/5, border white/10) followed by a vertical stack of Title (Cabinet Grotesk, 18px) and Status (Satoshi, 12px, neutral-400). Right side: Button group with 'Invoice PDF', 'Email', and 'Save' (border-white/10, bg-white/5) followed by a primary 'Send' button (#fcd34d background, neutral-950 text).

Container: 24px border-radius, dark gradient background (from white/5 to white/0.03). Header: Title 'Invoice editor' (Cabinet Grotesk, 24px) with status chips (Emerald-400 dot for 'Auto-calc'). Body: Stacked vertical sections separated by 24px spacing. Customer section: Selectable card with company icon. Details section: 2-column grid for inputs (Invoice number, Schedule, Currency, Date). Items section: Nested cards for each line item containing name, qty, unit, price, and tax inputs. Totals section: Summary area showing subtotal, tax, and a large display for the total amount.

Background: Neutral-50 (#fafafa) workspace. Preview Header: 40px logo, company name, and a toggle group for 'Preview/Print/Notes' inside a rounded-2xl container. Preview Card: A white (#ffffff) A4-style document with 32px internal padding. Layout: Top section with 'From' details vs large 'Invoice' title; Middle section with 'Billed to' details vs a summarized info grid (Issued, Due, Terms, Currency); Bottom section: Clean tabular data with 12px padding rows, followed by a total summary card and footer text.

special_ui_components.description: A nested data-entry card for invoice line items.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a card with bg-neutral-950/35 and 1px white/10 border. Header features 'Item #X' label and a 'Remove' button with trash icon. Body is a 2-column responsive grid with labeled inputs. Inputs use 12px border-radius, bg-neutral-950/40, and amber-300 ring on focus.

special_ui_components.description: High-contrast summary section for final financial figures.
special_ui_components.prompt: Use bg-white/5 for dark mode and bg-neutral-50 for light mode. Feature a horizontal divider. Display sub-totals in 14px text. The 'Total' amount should use 'Cabinet Grotesk' at 24px or 30px with semi-bold weight. Include a 'Ready to send' badge (bg-neutral-900, white text) for the preview version.
